sources.entry: spacy - A library for industrial-strength natural language processing in Python and Cython.

summary.one_liner: spaCy is an industrial-strength natural language processing library for Python, built on Cython, with pretrained pipelines and trainable neural models.
summary.what_it_does: spaCy provides tokenization and training for 70+ languages, along with pretrained pipelines for tagging, dependency parsing, named entity recognition, and text classification. It supports multi-task learning with pretrained transformers such as BERT, and includes pretrained word vectors and embeddings support. A training system handles config-driven training, model packaging, deployment and workflow management. Custom components and attributes can be added to the processing pipeline, and custom models in PyTorch or TensorFlow are supported. Built-in visualizers display syntax and NER output.
use_cases: training custom NLP models on your own data
packaging and deploying NLP pipelines to production
how_to_run: import spacy; nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm"); doc = nlp("This is a sentence.")
notable: Trained pipelines for 70+ languages installable as Python packages
Multi-task learning with pretrained transformers like BERT
Built-in visualizers for syntax and NER
Integration of large language models into pipelines
caveats: Building from source needs a C compiler and development headers, which is platform-dependent and the trickiest part
Models must be downloaded separately as packages; retraining is recommended after upgrades
